symptom: `mxcli fix widgets` on a project with 0 CE0463 rewrote 13 units that hold no widget (Java action, microflows, domain model, REST service); describe output identical before and after; a Java action's ExportLevel went from Public to Hidden.
cause: RunToolPreservingFormat harvests every unit `mx update-widgets` left that canon.Reconcile does not find semantically equal. mx re-saves units it loads — fills in default fields, reorders keys, normalises an enumeration value it does not know — so non-widget units differed and were written.
fix: For update-widgets only Forms$ units (pages, snippets, layouts, building blocks, page templates) are written back; any other re-saved unit is left as stored and listed. rename-design-properties is unscoped, as before.
insight: Separate the tool from the harvest before fixing either: running `mx update-widgets` directly on a copy and dumping the unit showed mx itself writes Hidden, so the harvest only made mx's re-save persistent. Scope a Mendix tool's write-back by what the tool is for, not by 'bytes differ'. Integration-measured with mx create-project + a stale Data grid 2 (addWidgetProperty): CE0463 11 -> 0 with the scope.
test: cmd/mxcli/docker/harvest_scope_2288_test.go (Forms$ written, Java action and microflow left as stored; control: rename-design-properties unscoped); fix_widgets_scope_integration_test.go (-tags integration, real mx: CE0463 cleared)
